featured_reviews.name: Ujjwal Dubey
featured_reviews.review_text: Working with WEY Foundation was a really meaningful experience for me. Under the guidance of Shirin Agarwal ma’am, we got to participate in beach cleanups, community surveys, and school activities. featured_reviews.review_text:
Working with WEY Foundation was a truly heart-touching experience. Being part of beach clean-up drives and the sports meet for children was incredibly meaningful. For many children, the sports meet was their first such experience, and their happiness was unforgettable.

featured_reviews.name: Ayesha Chunawala
featured_reviews.review_text:
Working with the WEY Foundation was a truly meaningful and enriching experience for me. Under the guidance of Shirin ma’am, we had the opportunity to participate in several impactful activities such as beach cleanups, community surveys, and school engagement programs. These activities helped us understand the importance of social responsibility and environmental awareness in a very practical way.

The experience was not limited to just volunteering, it allowed us to gain real insights into the challenges that many communities face in their daily lives. Through fieldwork and direct interaction with people, we were able to develop a deeper sense of empathy, awareness, and responsibility towards society.

The environment within the organization was extremely supportive and encouraging. The guidance helped us work effectively as a team, improve our communication skills, and learn how to approach social issues with a practical and responsible mindset.

Overall, this experience helped me grow both personally and socially. I am very grateful for the opportunity to work with WEY Foundation, and I would highly recommend this NGO to any student who is looking to gain meaningful field exposure and contribute positively to society.

name: Spark-A-Change Foundation
description:
We are an 8-yr old Mumbai-based registered Not-for-Profit entity, providing programs providing educational and vocational opportunities to children and youth from underserved backgrounds through various in-school and after school programs.
We impact over 1500 beneficiaries through our programs :
1. Anviksha Early Education Program – collaborations with MPS schools to support early education in 22 BMC classrooms
2. Anviksha Community Preschool – a free quality preschool for early learners
3. Foundational Learning Program – a volunteer driven program for grades 1-7
4. Board Ready Program – an tutorial program for students of grades 8-12
5. Youth Empowerment Program – a mentoring and support program for college students

name: ANIMEDH CHARITABLE TRUST
description:
ACT is a non-profit organization based in Mumbai, India. We pledge to ‘Act to make a difference’ to marginalized children, youth, women and vulnerable communities whose lives are bogged down by poverty or distress and who lack the opportunity to access their full potential, get education or generate income.

In India, women and children constitute more than 70% of the total population. But they remain marginalized, poor and socially excluded, especially in the weaker sections of our society. We are determined to reverse this social inequity. Our role as a civil society is to help fulfill their dreams of education, livelihood, inclusion, well-being and social justice.

featured_reviews.name: Jyoti Chile
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hi .. my self Jyoti chile.. a mother of twin babies who were born on this 31st Aug 2024.. my babies are born in preterm and currently admitted in Surya Hospital -Santacruz west... the NICU of Surya hospital is rated as no 1 in entire Asia.  My babies are currently undergoing with extreme low birth weight, extreme prematurity (25+2 weeks) and respiratory distress. Infants are currently on mechanical ventilation support, IV fluids and IV antibiotics. Hospital has given us the cost estimation of 44 Lakshmi for 3 months tenure.
While we approaching others trust I came across Reachout Foundation..I can certainly vouch for the saying "We are just a Call away" or "one call make a huge diffrence"... as per the name the Charity itself stands for help... I Reached out Deepa Mondal mam over call explained her mh medical aid requiremnt and the very next day I met her with all required documents... immediately the same day by evening I recd a donation from this Charity.. .. for a moment I was relaxed and beleived tht we do have people who are ready to help without expecting any thing... I and my husband will be forever grateful to Reachout Foundation  and Deepa Mondal Mam for supporting us and our babies in our hard time .. God Bless the Foundation 🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏

name: Arpan - Towards Freedom From Child Sexual Abuse.

Arpan is a globally recognised, award-winning non-profit dedicated to eliminating Child Sexual Abuse (CSA) in India.
Based in Mumbai, with a team of over 150 dedicated professionals, Arpan is India’s largest non-profit providing CSA Prevention and Intervention services for both children and adults. As a thought leader in CSA Prevention and Intervention, Arpan drives policy and systemic change at the local, state and national levels, through advocacy and research.
You can reach us at: info@arpan.org.in

featured_reviews.name: Dr Merin Mariam Mathews
featured_reviews.review_text: If I say something it will be less. Words can't explain the feeling of being a part of SWAG ICON of INDIA 2020.its been such a wonderful journey and also made me realize the worth of being myself at any cost.A lot of changes has happened in this journey for me as a person. Am sure that's the same feeling each contestant would have in thier mind now.initially when I signed up for this, I didn't know this was the exposure that was waiting me. I am thankful to Shabir for all his support and care he has taken to sign me up ,groom me and bring out the best in me. Like I said words are not enough to explain this journey. It's a beautiful feeling. From sorrow or darkness one day when you get to see light and feel breeze, the level of self satisfaction you get -that's SWAG BY SHABBIR ALI. His patience, his humble nature,his grooming, his inputs his team, everything has its own uniqueness. I joined late , but from day one each and everything happened in the journey Shabbir notices and if required corrects and motivates to be your best. Love you lots , God bless immensely with everything u wishes for.

I highly recommend working with Mr. Ali. I am happy to say I had a positive experience that I will cherish forever. Thank you Mr. Ali.
